body: Publication integration contract from DM-741 implementation: bindSprintLearningSource(ctx,{runId,sprintId,cardId}) uses the existing unique mapping with immutable stored snapshot. Generator must call this helper transactionally, not duplicate collector/hash logic or accept worker snapshots. Shared evidence refs now identify sourcePath and contentHash from exact bound items. Once the new guardrail-capable learning card kind exists, direct ordinary approve must fail closed for that kind until DM-728 uses prepare/integrate/finalize receipts; never let the current ordinary-card publish hook activate guardrail guidance before Git verification. Ordinary cards without learning metadata keep their existing behavior. No extra diagnostic/test infrastructure.
